# TinyCld — account brief

## Who
The resolve evidence identifies TinyCld only by its GitHub organization profile ([source](https://github.com/tinycld)). The evidence does not say what the company builds.

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json present in the tinycld/tinycld repo ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/58cc9155d30d589c0c73266331fd06cdaf14b1a4/eas.json))
- react-native 0.83.6 in tinycld/tinycld/package.json ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows in tinycld/tinycld ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- 14 public repos and 67 followers on the org ([source](https://github.com/tinycld))
- tinycld/tinycld last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld))

## Why now
The main repo was pushed as recently as 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld)) and it runs react-native 0.83.6 ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/main/package.json)). The evidence contains nothing on store update cadence or review volume, so recency here rests on repo activity alone.

## Suggested opener
I noticed tinycld/tinycld carries an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside GitHub Actions workflows ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/tree/main/.github/workflows)). You are also on react-native 0.83.6, which is close to current ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/main/package.json)). When you cut a release today, does EAS Build run from those workflows, or is the store submission step still manual?
